1.explanation: We wrap two FormGroup examples to match the vertical and horizontal layouts shown in the Figma images. Each RadioButton is given a new `readOnly` prop that adds a `.bx--radio-button--readonly` CSS modifier class and short-circuits the onChange to a no-op so clicks don’t change state. The checked states are driven by static local state (never updated) to lock in selection. The Storybook story renders both orientations side by side, and you can copy/paste this into `RadioButton.stories.tsx` (and add the modifier class in `RadioButton.jsx`) to verify the read-only styles and spacing match the spec.
1.bug_scenario:
The design calls for a new “read-only” state on our RadioButton component. In read-only mode, radios render exactly like the enabled component (with the same color tokens for unselected/selected and the same vertical/horizontal spacing) but do not respond to user clicks. The Figma callouts show:
• Unselected: icon-disabled ($icon-disabled) + text-placeholder ($text-placeholder)
• Selected: icon-primary ($icon-primary) + text-primary ($text-primary)
• Group label text: text-secondary ($text-secondary)
• Vertical grouping: 20 px between items, 8 px gutter before label
• Horizontal grouping: 20 px top, 8 px bottom, 16 px between items

Currently there is no `readOnly` prop on RadioButton, so we need to add it, apply a `bx--radio-button--readonly` modifier class, and ensure clicks don’t toggle selection.
